newsitem.title: USA: WTD sees profitable Q4, in range of Q1.
newsitem.headline: WTD sees profitable Q4, in range of Q1.

text.p: WTD Industries Inc said Wednesday that it expects results for its fourth quarter 1997 to be profitable and in the range of its results for the first quarter of 1997, barring any unexpected developments.
The company reported net income of $2.1 million or $0.14 a share in first quarter 1997 and said it would announce its fourth-quarter and year-end results in mid-June.

"Fiscal 1997 has been a dramatic turnaround from the $0.76 per share loss suffered in fiscal 1996," a company statement said. "We have benefited from more favorable conditions in the solid wood segment of the forest products industry, while the pulp and paper sector continues to languish."
It added that log supply remains stable and current lumber prices and demand are strong.
